inclusions.source: Transport: Round-trip transportation from your hotel.

inclusions.text: All admission fees for the evening's events
inclusions.source: Entrance Fees: All admission fees for the evening’s events are covered.

inclusions.text: One bottle of mineral water per person
inclusions.source: The outing takes bookings from a single person upward, with no minimum group, and one bottle of mineral water per person is provided.

inclusions.text: Private road transfer and motorboat crossing
inclusions.source: The road transfer and motorboat crossing are private to your party; the show itself is a shared, ticketed performance at the temple.

inclusions.text: Hotel pickup by driver in Aswan
inclusions.source: Your driver collects you from your Aswan hotel as the afternoon light is fading — timing varies by season and show schedule, so expect your pickup to be coordinated accordingly.
